summary: Pin acme-actions/deploy@main to a commit SHA in every workflow that uses it: 1 line to edit across 1 repo; removes 0 of 5 confirmed (principal, repo) pairs (0%)

plan.description: Pin acme-actions/deploy@main to a commit SHA in every workflow that uses it

steps.note: fix-plan works offline and does not know the commit main points at: run `gop pin --action acme-actions/deploy@main --graph graph.json` to resolve it with one read-only API call and print these edits as a git apply diff, or replace <sha-of-main> with the full commit SHA of main yourself. Use the same SHA in every step.

caveats: acme-app/docs .github/workflows/build.yml line 9: stale actions.lock entry (it pins acme-actions/deploy@v1 instead): rerun gh actions-lock in acme-app/docs instead of editing the workflow
acme-app/web .github/workflows/ci.yml line 8: actions.lock governs this uses: and pins it to aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa: nothing to edit
diffs show the uses: entry without its indentation or list marker; keep those as they are in the file

pinning acme-actions/deploy@main alone does not close paths through the mutable refs it uses itself: acme-actions/setup@main (acme-actions/deploy@main action.yml:6). Pin those too (for example gop fix-plan --pin action:acme-actions/setup@main)
